stats.vpipTooltip: VPIP (Voluntarily Put In Pot): % of hands where player voluntarily put chips in the pot
stats.pfrTooltip: PFR (Pre-Flop Raise): % of hands where player raised in the first round
stats.threeBetTooltip: 3Bet: % of hands where player re-raised an opponent's raise
stats.afTooltip: AF (Aggression Factor): ratio of aggressive actions (bet/raise) to passive actions (call)

tutorial.playerHand: Your cards. Some are face-down (only you see them) and some face-up (everyone sees them). The high hand is ordinary seven-card stud.
tutorial.actionButtons: Choose your action: Bet, Call, Raise, Fold, or All In.
tutorial.potDisplay: Shows the current pot size and ante levels.
tutorial.cpuArea: CPU opponent information. Cards are revealed at showdown.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.
tutorial.spade: Half the pot goes to whoever holds **the highest spade among their face-down cards**. Face-up spades do not count. The ace of spades is the highest, then the king, the queen, and so on.
tutorial.split: At the showdown the pot halves: one half to the best hand, the other to the highest spade in the hole. The odd chip goes to the high side.
tutorial.scoop: If nobody holds a spade face-down, the high hand takes the whole pot. Taking both halves is called a scoop.

frontendHint.sevencardstudBringIn: You are forced in on the lowest door card — that is not a strong hand
frontendHint.sevencardstudPlayLow: Five cards of eight or lower — weak for high, but live for half the pot
frontendHint.sevencardstudCheckFree: Nothing to call — take the next card for free
frontendHint.sevencardstudCallHigh: You hold a high card — call and see the next street
frontendHint.sevencardstudFoldWeak: No pair and no high card — fold
frontendHint.sevencardstudCheckLow: Five cards of eight or lower and nothing to call — take the next card for free

style.tagTooltip: Tight Aggressive: plays few hands but bets strongly when in
style.lagTooltip: Loose Aggressive: plays many hands and bets strongly
style.tpTooltip: Tight Passive: plays few hands, mostly calls
style.lpTooltip: Loose Passive: plays many hands but rarely raises

split.title: Pot split
split.hiTakesAll: Nobody holds a spade face-down, so the high hand takes the whole pot.
